svg.title: TerraPolis (2025 – 2026)
svg.desc: TerraPolis, 2025 to 2026: AR city simulation driven by Deep Reinforcement Learning. Python engine and Unity AR client.
svg.text: augmented reality · project lead, team of 3 · ENSIM
AR city simulation (pollution, floods) driven by Deep Reinforcement Learning: I led the
team and built most of the AI (CNN, curriculum training in PyTorch).
Over 1,000 games, the AI scores 4.75× a random strategy on average.
